beats.care: Proof that talent plus support wins. Para sport deserves your follow, not just at medal time.
beats.what: India won 114 medals: 30 gold, 35 silver and 49 bronze. Nine golds came on the final day.
beats.why: India sent 168 athletes, about half the Hangzhou 2023 squad, and still beat that record.

cards.body: Shuttlers Nitesh Kumar and Naveen Sivakumar won gold, Mona won in shooting, and Sandeep ran a 400m world record. Separately, Pankaj Advani won his 29th world title in billiards.
India did it with a squad about half the size of its last one.

cards.q: How many medals did India win at these Asian Para Games?
cards.why: India won 114 medals, its best ever.

cover.label: medals, India's best ever at the Asian Para Games

learn.t: Pankaj Advani has now won 29 world titles in cue sports, an unmatched record.
